title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.47: The ally-selection prompt for Pass the Mic / Duet now happens during that card's own play (not the resolver's) and is paused correctly through the multiplayer action framework, fixing the state-divergence risk from v1.13.46. When an ordered resolver (Workshop/Showtime/Da Capo/Spectacle) auto-plays one, you pick the ally via the targeting reticle; Remix and the Intermission turn-end auto-play still pick randomly; no prompt appears with only one ally (2-player unchanged).
